test_title: PYST 12: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As of July 2025, how many Indian States have a bicameral legislature (i.e. both, a Legislative Assembly and a Legislative Council)?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Six**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India has a **federal parliamentary system** and legislative bodies at both the central and state levels.
 
• A bicameral legislature consists of two houses: the **Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha)** and the **Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad).**
 
• As of **July 2025**, there are **six Indian states** with a bicameral legislature. These states are **Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Bihar, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana.**
 
• The **Legislative Council** is a permanent body and cannot be dissolved, but members retire in rotation.
 
• The creation or abolition of a Legislative Council is governed by **Article 169** of the Indian Constitution. A state legislature can pass a resolution by a special majority to create or abolish a council.
 
• The **Legislative Assembly**, on the other hand, is directly elected by the people of the state and has significant powers, including passing state laws, budget approvals, and discussions on government policies.
 
• Bicameral legislatures are intended to ensure better representation of diverse interests and to provide a mechanism for deeper scrutiny of legislation.
 
• The states with bicameral legislatures represent a mix of **large populations, economic significance, and historical contexts** that justify the presence of two houses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Eight States**__

 __
 
• India has only **six states** with bicameral legislatures, not eight. This option is incorrect as it suggests a higher number than the actual count.
 
 
 
• **Seven States**__
 __
 
• This option is incorrect as India has **six states** with bicameral legislatures, not seven.
 
 
 
• **Five States**__
 
 
• While some states have unicameral legislatures, the number of states with bicameral legislatures in India is **six**, making this option incorrect.
